# MESH

> Mesh is a local proxy that lowers what requests to Anthropic (Claude) and
> OpenAI-compatible APIs cost, for teams whose products call an LLM API
> constantly (agents, coding, support, RAG, multi-agent systems). It records
> every request in a hash-chained ledger on your own machine, and charges 1%
> of verified savings, monthly, nothing else; a month that saved nothing
> bills nothing. You can recompute any invoice yourself with `mesh verify`.
> Mesh has no customers yet and has not run on any customer's traffic.
>
> Every figure below is from docs/NUMBERS.md (last reconciled 2026-10-27).
> LIVE = real API calls: 18.2% net savings on one mixed 30-request basket
> (claude-sonnet-5-5, run 2026-10-26, $0.0365 saved of $0.2010 spent); it is
> one small run, not a measurement of any customer's bill, and Mesh has not
> yet measured its effect on a real provider bill. SIMULATOR = modelled at
> providers' published prices, not proven on a real bill: async/batch 57.7%
> net, one-shot templated 45.5% and 72.8%, sparse interactive 34.3%, busy
> interactive 25.9-29.4%, multi-turn Claude cache lever alone 37.9%. The 57.3%
> full-stack simulator comparison loses 5 pp of clean tasks against a raw
> uncached baseline and fails the -2 pp quality limit, so it is not a
> qualified win. Already-optimised stacks: 0-5%, and the verdict is "do not
> pay us". Which levers were switched on for each figure is on evidence.html.

## Install
Open to everyone, no signup. Install with one command on macOS, Linux or WSL:
`curl -fsSL https://www.mesh-technology.com/install.sh | sh` (or
`npm install -g @harrym1707/mesh`; needs Node 22+). Then `mesh start` for
Claude Code, or `mesh proxy` for any app: set the client's base URL to
http://127.0.0.1:8787 (Anthropic) or http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1 (OpenAI and
compatibles) and keep your own key. `mesh verify` recomputes the invoice from
the ledger the customer holds, with no network calls. Without installing:
`npx -y -p @harrym1707/sdk mesh-proxy` runs the proxy alone, and the invoice
is recomputable with verifyLedgerChain and recomputeInvoice from that package. Quote from an
existing LiteLLM/Helicone/Langfuse export without routing any traffic:
`npx -y -p @harrym1707/sdk mesh-quote your-export.jsonl --format litellm`.

Long-lived agents re-send their history every turn; Mesh keeps it on the
provider's cached rate with guards, and caps oversized tool results. How much
that is worth depends on the workload (see the per-segment page); the
pilot runbook gives a quote from your own logs without routing any traffic.
